paragraphs.text: This is the first paragraph of the sample book. It exists so that you can try out the EGW Library plugin before importing real books. Its reference is SB 9.1.
This is the second paragraph on page nine, so its reference is SB 9.2. Try finding it with the search box by typing its reference.
This paragraph starts on page ten, which makes it SB 10.1. You can list every paragraph on this page by searching for SB 10.
The second chapter begins here on page eleven. You can list this whole chapter by searching for SB ch 2.

A longer paragraph is useful for testing the automatic slide splitting. When a paragraph does not fit on one slide, OpenLP automatically continues it on the next slide, in the same way that long Bible verses are handled. This paragraph repeats itself a little so that it has some length to it. When a paragraph does not fit on one slide, OpenLP automatically continues it on the next slide, so nothing is ever cut off.
This final paragraph is SB 12.1. Full text search works too: try searching for the word slide with the sample book selected.
